title: Constitution of a Monitoring Cell by the President of the National Commission

content.scenario: The President of the National Commission wants to oversee the functioning of the State Commissions from an administrative point of view. The President decides to constitute a monitoring cell for this purpose.
content.outcome: The President of the National Commission constitutes a monitoring cell to oversee the functioning of the State Commissions from the administrative point of view, as per Section 70(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the purpose of a monitoring cell in the National Commission?
How does the National Commission oversee State Commissions?
What are the responsibilities of the President of the National Commission?
